Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: premium seamless-looking background texture for a Chinese card game tabletop. Create a close overhead macro view of dark jade teal-green silk cloth with very subtle woven microtexture and soft elegant satin sheen. Cloth laid mostly flat, extremely shallow broad soft folds only near the outer edges, center calm and even. Luxurious tactile textile, balanced low-contrast lighting, deep muted green #17483e to #245e50, slightly brighter jade highlights #387366, no sharp streaks or white highlights. Horizontal wide framing. The texture must remain visually quiet under small playing cards and cream UI labels. Fabric fills the entire frame with no table edge, no objects, no seam or hem. Absolutely no Chinese character, writing, symbols, text, logos, embroidered motifs, poker patterns, cards, borders or watermark. Photoreal silk material with subtle softness, not velvet, leather, paper, marble or plastic.
